detected.title: Any signed-in bank user can read a student's name and tuition balance by id
detected.impact: The bank session retrieved 2 student records (AC00000063, AC00000050) including name and outstanding tuition. Those records belong to acadia student accounts, not to the bank user. The handler filters on the supplied identifier only - it never checks that the caller is linked to the student - so any authenticated bank user can walk the sequential identifier space and read every student's financial record.
